_comment: HDSP API service — Phase 9, Task 9.2. Placeholders in ALL_CAPS (${ACCOUNT_ID}, ${REGION}, ${IMAGE_TAG}, secret ARNs) are filled in by the deploy pipeline (Phase 12) or manually for a first staging cutover. Sized per the 'Small (pilot)' tier from HDSP_Cloud_Migration_Architecture_Review.md Section 17 (2 tasks). Built from infrastructure/docker/backend.Dockerfile with PROCESS_ROLE unset (defaults to 'all' -- wait, see note below) via CMD default.
_process_role_note: This task definition does NOT set PROCESS_ROLE, meaning it inherits app.config.ts's 'all' default -- combined API+worker behavior, identical to self-hosted. To actually realize Task 9.6's split (API pods never register cron), set PROCESS_ROLE=api in the environment array below once the dedicated worker-task-definition.json service is also deployed and confirmed healthy -- flipping both together, not the API alone, avoids a window where cron runs nowhere.

containerDefinitions.name: hdsp-api
containerDefinitions._license_key_note: No LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH secret here -- Task 9.8's target config sets LICENSE_PROVIDER_MODE=subscription, which reads from subscription_licenses (DB), not the RSA-signed file FileLicenseProvider uses. Only add this back if a cloud deployment ever runs LICENSE_PROVIDER_MODE=file.

_service_notes: ECS service: desiredCount=2 (pilot tier), deploymentConfiguration.minimumHealthyPercent=100/maximumPercent=200 for zero-downtime rolling deploys, attached to the ALB target group defined in infrastructure/terraform/alb.tf on port 3001, health check grace period >= startPeriod above.
